S.FORM: = Carapongay = Gaga mniq Taytung Cangpinsyang ka alang Carapongay. 33 sapah ka kneegu na sapah, 82 hiyi ka kana knhbragan na hiyi. Tnpusu seejiq o mangal 73% niqan 60 hiyi sp, rahuq na uxay tnpusu seejiq o mangal 27% niqan 22 hiyi koia. Kana ka kleegan seejiq ga, Amis62%, Bunun1%, Tayal2%, Puyuma1%, Truku2%. Pusu nniqan alang Ruwan alang Cingsan o niqan tru sslian alang. Nniqan alang Nuysan Pingtung nsgan Santimung alang Cingsan. Gasuc Dgiyaq Cingsan o gaga mniq alang hunac gqiyan hidaw, dhuq dgiyaq Weyryawsan saw hari hunac gqiyan hidaw 8km. Tiri lnglingay Dxgal sttu hari, saw hari 125~150 knjisan. Pgkla patas cyawtung Mgrig rulu: Taypey>Kwotaw tg3>cyworu cyawrywotaw>elug cyworu>elug sanmin>elug wucyuan>elug tungning>elug rwoning>elug cifen>elug cangswo>Ping tg>Elug sngri>elug syi>elug qnpahan nansing>elug cungyang>Ping27> dgiyaq kssiyaw elug>dhuq. Klgan sjiqan nealang Seejiq Paywan. Djiyun kari Kari Paywan ni kari Tlu. Snhiyan cungcyaw Pusu Gaya kndsan dha. Pnaah alang Mnuda kska alang ka yayung Pucyang, ga ssiyaw yayung ka alang, quri saw igi 1-5 rin hiya o tmhangan dha Sekauman ,narac 6rin hiya o tmhangan dha sivalatje ,daya hari o 7rin setaizuazua ,mslagu ni pqita ka lalang, tru alnag hiya sayang o, kingal kmlawa singcng, mntna ni tmhangan dha"Mincusyang", kiya ka kiya ni kari seejiq tnpusu kana. Pgkla patas rmigaw Pusu bi pnhyugan sapah: Nuysan Pingtung nsgan Santimung alang Cingsan mincusyang tg9. Saan qtaan rmigaw nniqan: ◎Haysenkung ‧ Shuya musa ka Haysenkung Ppanan rulu: Kndadax tunux sngayan rurlu qrngul dhuq nsgan Kawsu alang Kawsu do tucing rulu na basu quri Mawrin, Tacin, Kawsu, mkksa quri alang Samo 90 minute dungan do kika dhuq da. Mgrig su na rulu:kwotaw tg3 haw cangc cyawrywotaw →Sngtaw tay24syeyn →Syeyntaw 185siyeyn→ Taywan→ Haysenkung ◎Qyqaya hnici rudan sbiyaw Paywan yisukwan.
S.PHON: ʦaɾapoŋaj gaga mniq tajtuŋ ʦaŋpinsjaŋ ka alaŋ ʦaɾapoŋaj ** sapaħ ka knəəgu na sapaħ ** ħiji ka kana knħbɾagan na ħiji tnpusu səəɟiq o maŋal ** niqan ** ħiji sp ɾaħuq na uxaj tnpusu səəɟiq o maŋal ** niqan ** ħiji koia kana ka kləəgan səəɟiq ga amis** bunun* tajal* pujuma* tɾuku* pusu nniqan alaŋ ɾuwan alaŋ ʦiŋsan o niqan tɾu sslian alaŋ nniqan alaŋ nujsan piŋtuŋ nsgan santimuŋ alaŋ ʦiŋsan gasuʦ dgijaq ʦiŋsan o gaga mniq alaŋ ħunaʦ gqijan ħidaw dħuq dgijaq weɾjawsan saw ħaɾi ħunaʦ gqijan ħidaw *km tiɾi lŋliŋaj dxgal sttu ħaɾi saw ħaɾi ****** knɟisan pgkla patas ʦjawtuŋ mgɾig ɾulu tajpekwotaw tg*ʦjwoɾu ʦjawɾjwotawəlug ʦjwoɾuəlug sanminəlug wuʦjuanəlug tuŋniŋəlug ɾwoniŋəlug ʦi*ənəlug ʦaŋswopiŋ tgəlug sŋɾiəlug sjiəlug qnpaħan nansiŋəlug ʦuŋjaŋpiŋ** dgijaq kssijaw əlugdħuq klgan sɟiqan nəalaŋ səəɟiq pajwan dɟijun kaɾi kaɾi pajwan ni kaɾi tlu snħijan ʦuŋʦjaw pusu gaja kndsan dħa pnaaħ alaŋ mnuda kska alaŋ ka jajuŋ puʦjaŋ ga ssijaw jajuŋ ka alaŋ quɾi saw igi ** ɾin ħija o tmħaŋan dħa səkauman naɾaʦ *ɾin ħija o tmħaŋan dħa si*alatɟə daja ħaɾi o *ɾin sətai*ua*ua mslagu ni pqita ka lalaŋ tɾu alnag ħija sajaŋ o kiŋal kmlawa siŋʦŋ mntna ni tmħaŋan dħaminʦusjaŋ kija ka kija ni kaɾi səəɟiq tnpusu kana pgkla patas ɾmigaw pusu bi pnħjugan sapaħ nujsan piŋtuŋ nsgan santimuŋ alaŋ ʦiŋsan minʦusjaŋ tg* saan qtaan ɾmigaw nniqan *ħajsənkuŋ sħuja musa ka ħajsənkuŋ ppanan ɾulu kndadax tunux sŋajan ɾuɾlu qɾŋul dħuq nsgan kawsu alaŋ kawsu do tuʦiŋ ɾulu na basu quɾi mawɾin taʦin kawsu mkksa quɾi alaŋ samo ** minutə duŋan do kika dħuq da mgɾig su na ɾulukwotaw tg* ħaw ʦaŋʦ ʦjawɾjwotaw *sŋtaw taj**sjen *sjentaw ***sijen* tajwan* ħajsənkuŋ *qjqaja ħniʦi ɾudan sbijaw pajwan jisukwan
